assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready transparent pixel-art treasure icon sprite atlas for an educational fantasy RPG. Create exactly TEN different equipment icons in EXACTLY five equally spaced columns and two equally spaced rows, read left-to-right across top row then bottom row. The entire image must have a 5:2 aspect ratio (for example 2560x1024) so each invisible cell is square. Each item needs a vivid crisp 16-bit JRPG pixel-art silhouette, hard square pixel clusters, dark purple outline, careful jewel-like highlights, not smooth vector art or realistic rendering.
